summary: SDK 58 regression test. Backend: 19/19 pytest pass against the public URL. Web preview at 390x844: loads with no red screen and no runtime errors. Role select, admin login (wrong and correct password), 4 admin tabs with Ionicons, add farmer, add milk entry (manual fat/snf/liters, live rate preview), add advance, farmer detail, farmer login (wrong and correct phone), farmer-home, session survives reload, and logout all work, and data was checked through the API. ROOT CAUSE of 'can't see app in my phone': the expo supervisor command is `expo export -p web` + `npx serve dist`, so no Metro dev server runs. Expo Go gets index.html instead of a manifest or bundle, so the QR / Expo Go flow cannot work. 'Refused to connect' in preview most likely comes from the ~50s+ window during each restart while the export runs and `npx serve` is downloaded again (expo.err.log shows serve@14.2.6 / 14.2.7 being installed on each start). In that window nothing listens on port 3000. Also, SDK 58 needs the SDK-58 Expo Go app (released Oct 2026), so a phone with an older Expo Go cannot open the project. UI bug: admin bottom tab labels are clipped. Deprecated packages detected: none (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch; @expo/vector-icons fully replaced). SafeAreaView issues detected: none (all imports come from react-native-safe-area-context).

minor.issue: Returns admin_password in plain text with no auth. Anyone can read the admin password.
No auth or token checks. Farmers, entries, advances and settings can be changed by anyone with the URL.
next_farmer_code() uses count_documents()+1, so the generated code can collide with an existing code after deletions or custom codes, and the request returns 400 'already exists'.
Returns ok:true even when the id does not exist (no 404).

ui_bugs.issue: Tab labels Home/Farmers/Entries/Settings are clipped: the label text box is at y=828-833, so only 5px is visible inside the 56px tab bar (height 56 + paddingTop 6 + paddingBottom 6 on web, where insets.bottom=0). Increase the height to about 64, or drop the fixed height or padding.

integration_issues.issue: No Metro dev server is running. A manifest request with the expo-platform header and /index.bundle?platform=ios both return the static index.html. Expo Go cannot load the app. Supervisor runs `yarn expo export -p web ... && npx serve -s dist -l 3000`.

Each restart re-exports the web bundle (8MB, unminified) and downloads `serve` again with npx before port 3000 starts listening, so the preview shows 'refused to connect' for roughly 50s+ after each restart, or longer if the npm download is slow or fails.

After save (and on the header back button), router.back() is called with no canGoBack() fallback. On a direct URL or refresh this logs 'GO_BACK was not handled' and the user stays on the form. The data still saves.

issues: The logo image shows a white square sticking out of the circular brand-logo container. It needs overflow:hidden or a matching borderRadius.

react_native_issues.issue: useNativeDriver:true triggers a 'native animated module is missing' warning on web. Use Platform.OS !== 'web'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/Toast.tsx:25
The project is on SDK 58 (expo ^58, RN 0.88.1). A phone needs the SDK-58 Expo Go build; older Expo Go versions refuse SDK 58 projects. Reference: /app/frontend/package.json:24

action_items: HIGH: For the phone/Expo Go flow, a Metro dev server (e.g. `expo start --tunnel --port 3000`) must be serving the manifest. The current static export + serve setup only works for the web preview. Restore the standard expo start command, or make sure the tunnel/dev server is running for Expo Go, and confirm that the user's Expo Go version supports SDK 58.
HIGH: Reduce preview downtime. Avoid `npx serve` downloading on each start (install serve as a devDependency or globally), and note that the preview refuses connections during the export.
MEDIUM: Fix the clipped tab bar labels in app/admin/_layout.tsx (raise the height or remove the fixed height).
LOW: Add a canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/admin') fallback in add-entry, advance-new, farmer-new and farmer-detail.
LOW: Stop returning admin_password from GET /api/settings, use max-code-based farmer code generation, and return 404 from DELETE for missing ids.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: admin_password is stored in plain text and exposed through the public GET /settings.
server.py:180 next_farmer_code is count-based, which can produce duplicate codes.
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (src/lib/api.ts:2), which matches frontend/.env, so this is OK.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_dairy_backend.py (rate/settings assertions now derived from live settings; base_rate is user-configured as 37; settings revert restores the original value; removed the localhost default)

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all functional flows pass; tab label clipping bug; Expo Go on phone not working due to server setup)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_SDK58 Farmer (T958) with 2 entries and 1 advance. Deleted by id afterwards (cascade). Pre-existing T901 TEST_Regression Farmer was left untouched. Test settings change on dairy_phone was reverted to the original value.

The farmer-home logout testID is header-right-button; admin logout is logout-btn on the settings tab. Settings base_rate=37 is user data, do not change it.
rca_of_issue: Phone: supervisor's expo program serves a static web export only, so Expo Go receives HTML instead of a manifest (verified with curl using the expo-platform header). Preview 'refused to connect': port 3000 is not listening while `expo export` runs and `npx serve` is downloaded on each restart. Once up, it returns 200 and the app works fully.
